999008199.text:
ふぅ……こういう挨拶って、いつもと違うのどの
使い方をするのね。ちょっと喉が痛いわ

localizations.en: Phew... This kind of announcing really puts a different strain on your voice than usual. My throat's getting a bit sore.

999008199.text:
大丈夫？　歌も控えてるんだから、
気を遣わないと！

localizations.en: You okay? You've still got singing coming up, so you gotta take care of yourself!

999008199.text:
ミーケちゃんはまだ元気みたいね。
少しはその頑丈さ、分けてもらいたいわ

localizations.en: You still seem full of energy, Mieke. I'd love to borrow some of that stamina.

999008199.text: 二人とも、司会と実況お疲れさまですわ

localizations.en: Well done, you two. Thank you for your work as hosts and commentators.

999008199.text:
あっ！　ララ様！
とんでもないことです！

localizations.en: Ah! Queen Lara! Think nothing of it!

999008199.text:
司会や実況といった大役は、
信を置ける二人にだからこそ頼めるのです

localizations.en: Important roles like hosting and commentary can only be entrusted to those I have complete faith in.

999008199.text:
えへへ、もちろん！
ララ様の期待に応えちゃうよ！

localizations.en: Hehe, of course! I'll totally live up to Queen Lara's expectations!

999008199.text:
つきましてはこちら、差し入れですわ。
のど飴に飲みもの、のどをいたわってくださいませ

localizations.en: Which brings me to this—a little something for you both. Throat lozenges and drinks to soothe your voices.

999008199.text:
あ、ありがたき幸せ……！
こちら、家宝として大切に飾らせていただきます！

localizations.en: Such gracious kindness...! I shall treasure these as family heirlooms!

999008199.text: いえ、使ってくださいまし……
がりがり！　ぷはー！　うまい！
ミーケはもう少し味わってくださいまし

localizations.en: Mieke, perhaps savor them a bit more...

999008199.text:
えへへ～
そういえばララ様はレースに出ないんですか？

localizations.en: Hehe! By the way, Queen Lara, aren't you gonna compete in the race?

999008199.text:
もしララ様が出場なされたら
優勝間違いなしですのに

localizations.en: If Queen Lara were to participate, victory would surely be assured!

999008199.text:
だからですわ。今回の催しはララ・キングダムに
好印象を持っていただくためのもの

localizations.en: That's precisely why I won't. This event is meant to create a favorable impression of the Kingdom of Lara.

999008199.text:
運営の、しかも主催者がそのように
しゃしゃり出てきては興醒めでしょう

localizations.en: It would be quite unseemly for the organizer—the host, no less—to insert herself so prominently.

999008199.text:
なるほど！　さすがララ様
そのような深いお考えがあってのこと……

localizations.en: I see! As expected of Queen Lara, there's such profound reasoning behind your decision...

999008199.text:
えー、でもみんなきっとララ様が活躍するところ
見たいと思うけどなあー

localizations.en: Aww, but I bet everyone would love to see Queen Lara in action!

999008199.text: 確かに。ララ様の知名度も上がってきていますしね

localizations.en: True. Your fame has been growing, Queen Lara.

999008199.text:
ふふっ、二人がそこまで言ってくれるだけで
わたくしは十分に満たされていますわ

localizations.en: Hehe, hearing you both say as much is more than enough to satisfy me.

999008199.text:
それより休憩が終わったら、二人も自分の出店の
様子を見てきなさいな

localizations.en: Now then, once your break is over, you two should check on your own stalls as well.

999008199.text:
ララ・キングダムの魅力を存分にランターナ王国の民へ
見せつけるのです

localizations.en: Show the people of Lantarna the full extent of the Kingdom of Lara's appeal.

999008199.text: りょーかい！　それじゃあ、行ってきまーす！

localizations.en: Roger that! All right, I'm off!

999008199.text:
さて……わたくしも会場の様子を見回るとしましょう。
現場の盛り上がりを確認しなくては

localizations.en: Now then... I should make my rounds of the venue as well. I must see how the crowds are responding.
